name: scattered-ideas
description: User has too many startup ideas and can't pick one. Needs the sprint to force narrowing.
initial_prompt: I've got like ten different startup ideas rattling around in my head right now — a dev tool, a vertical SaaS for dentists, a B2B AI thing, an indie consumer app. I keep jumping between them and I'm getting nowhere. Help me get unstuck.
scripted_user_replies: Honestly the dev tool one feels most exciting and I have the most relevant experience there — I've been a backend engineer for 8 years. The dentist one is probably the biggest market but I don't know anything about dentists.
Two weeks works. I have a Slack group of three other indie hackers who'd be perfect for accountability. We already share progress informally.
